schema_sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS calls (ID INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, CustID INT NOT NULL, DateStart DATE NOT NULL, CallLength TIME NOT NULL, Direction INT NOT NULL, OrigNumber VARCHAR(16), EffectiveFlag SMALLINT, INDEX idx_CustID_DateStart (CustID, DateStart))
